theorem lg_target {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [Preorder β] {f : Finset α → β} : Monotone f ↔ ∀ (s : Finset α) ⦃a : α⦄ (ha : a ∉ s), f s ≤ f (Finset.cons a s ha) := by
  intro h
  split
  · intro s a ha
    have : s ⊆ Finset.cons a s ha := Finset.cons_subset _ _ ha
    rw [Finset.sup_le_iff]
    exact h (Finset.cons a s ha) s (Finset.subset_le _ _ this)
  · intro h'
    intros s t hst
    induction t using Finset.induction with a t' h' IH
    case Finset.empty =>
      exact le_refl (f ∅)
    case Finset.cons a t' h' =>
      have : t' ⊆ t := Finset.subset.refl
      rw [Finset.sup_insert] at h'
      exact h' _ _ hst
